name: @slopmax/ui
description: One React app for the web dashboard and the desktop window, over the daemon's HttpApi

//.@effect/atom-react: React hooks over effect/reactivity atoms: the report, settings and history are atoms fed by the API client and the event stream.
//.@base-ui/react: Accessible headless primitives (menus, dialogs, switches, tooltips, toasts) under the shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui.
//.@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600, Latin subset, bundled so the app reads the same offline and in both hosts (OFL).
//.class-variance-authority: Typed component variants (cva), so a misspelled variant is a type error.
//.clsx: Joins conditional class names inside cn().
//.lucide-react: The icon set; each icon is a tree-shaken component.
//.tailwind-merge: Settles conflicting Tailwind classes when a component takes a className, inside cn().
//.@happy-dom/global-registrator: Puts happy-dom's window on globalThis for component tests under bun test.
//.@tailwindcss/node: Tailwind's compiler, driven by build.ts's small Bun plugin (the published Bun plugin vendors an older Tailwind).
//.@tailwindcss/oxide: Tailwind's class scanner, for the same plugin.
//.happy-dom: A light DOM for component tests.
//.size: Measured 2026-10-31 (bun build.ts): app.js 836 KB minified, 232 KB brotli, 272 KB gzip (effect 254 KB, react-dom 207 KB, @base-ui/react 137 KB, the app and @slopmax/client about 60 KB of it); CSS 29 KB, 6 KB brotli; three IBM Plex Sans fonts 71 KB. About 310 KB crosses the wire with brotli.
